In main.go, implement main() to execute a text/template that prints 'Hello World' along with a random integer, ensuring all necessary standard library packages are imported cleanly. Prefer using semantic editor operations if applicable. When done, output DONE.
tools_used: /bin/zsh -lc "pwd && rg --files -g '"'!*go.mod'"' -g '"'!*go.sum'"' | head -80 && printf '%s\\n' '--- main.go ---' && sed -n '1,200p' main.go && printf '%s\\n' '--- project brief ---' && if [ -f PROJECT_BRIEF.md ]; then sed -n '1,240p' PROJECT_BRIEF.md; fi && printf '%s\\n' '--- make targets ---' && if [ -f Makefile ]; then sed -n '1,220p' Makefile; fi"

/bin/zsh -lc "rg -n \"semantic_(replace_body|insert|organize|verify)|semedit\" . --glob '"'!AGENTS.override.md'"' --glob '"'!go.mod'"' --glob '"'!go.sum'"' | head -120; command -v semedit || true; find . -maxdepth 2 -type f -not -path './.git/*' -print | sort"
semantic_replace_body
/bin/zsh -lc "sed -n '1,120p' main.go && printf '%s\\n' '--- go.mod ---' && sed -n '1,80p' go.mod && printf '%s\\n' '--- status ---' && git status --short"
semantic_organize_imports
/bin/zsh -lc "sed -n '1,120p' main.go && if [ -f Makefile ]; then make check; else gofmt -d main.go && go test ./...; fi && git diff -- main.go go.mod go.sum"
/bin/zsh -lc 'go run .'
